lines.en: I push off my hind legs in a short hop.
The splash is small when I land.
I lie on a lily pad.
I crawl two steps with my forelegs.
The leaf sways; I switch to another.

lines.zh: 水面的涟漪一圈圈散开。
lines.en: Ripples spread in rings.
I stop and puff my throat.
I hop two steps along the bank.
I kick off and shift an inch.
I slip between the reeds.
I kick my hind legs across the shallows.
My legs kick behind me.

lines.zh: 我扒着泥，把自己拖上去。
lines.en: I claw the mud and haul myself up.
I squat on a stone to warm my back.
Water runs down my back.
I hop back into the water.
I hide in the leaf's shadow.

lines.zh: 我躲进叶影里，我开始等。
lines.en: In the leaf's shadow, I begin to wait.
I lie with my eyes above the water.
I puff my throat without a sound.
I hold still, waiting for a bug.
I lie there. The water is warm.
A leaf drifts beside me.
I lie still and blink slowly.
A layer of warm light floats on the water.
My skin is always cool and wet.
I fold my forelegs under my chest.

lines.zh: 芦苇的影子落下来，远处有水声。
lines.en: Reed shadows fall. Water sounds far off.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪前腿，换个趴法。
lines.en: I shift my forelegs and re-settle.
I puff my throat and call.
The sound doesn't carry far.
I hold still and wait for the water to calm.
I raise my head and look at you.
You stand on the bank, enormous.

lines.zh: 我往后缩，只留鼻子在外。
lines.en: I shrink back, leaving only my nose out.
Only my eyes show.

lines.zh: 我朝水里缩了缩，你却一动不动。
lines.en: I shrink toward the water. You don't move.
I lift myself a little.
I peek from under a leaf at your boots.
Your shadow covers the water.
I watch you from the shadow.
Your boots are muddy.
The pain bounces me up.

lines.zh: 我一跳老高，背上皮开肉裂。
lines.en: I leap high, my skin splitting open.

lines.zh: 皮肤裂开了，我往水里钻。
lines.en: Skin split, I dive into the water.
I tuck beneath a lily pad.

lines.zh: 缩在叶底，浑身仍在打颤。
lines.en: Under the leaf, I'm still trembling.

lines.zh: 我伸舌头，舔了舔破皮处。
lines.en: My tongue finds the torn skin.
One hind leg won’t pull its weight.

lines.zh: 躲进水里之后，这一下很疼。
lines.en: In the water, it still hurts.
My leg won't obey, but I can swim.
I thrash twice before settling.
A wing's shadow falls before me.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西，我看见了。
lines.en: I see what you set down.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥，一点点蹭过去。
lines.en: Along the mud, I creep closer.

lines.zh: 我一点点凑近，舌头弹了出去。
lines.en: I creep closer and snap my tongue out.
Tongue out. Just short.
Just short. A little closer.
One inch closer, and I have it.
Got it. Tastes good.
Tastes good. Step back.
Back up. I want more.
The bump tips me into the water.

lines.zh: 一撞把我掀进水里，我划水逃开。
lines.en: The blow tips me in. I paddle away.
I'm shoved sliding into the water.
I surface under a leaf.

lines.zh: 水花被激得很高，你压得太重。
lines.en: The splash goes high. You're far too heavy.
I hide behind the reeds.
The surface slowly stills.

lines.zh: 藏进苇丛，我抖得停不下来。
lines.en: In the reeds, I can't stop shaking.
Still trembling. It's safe here.

lines.zh: 这儿稳妥，我不往外走了。
lines.en: It's safe here. I'm not going out.
Another one in the reeds.

lines.zh: 苇丛深处有同伴，它先叫了一声。
lines.en: Another in the reeds. It calls first.
I puff my throat and answer.

lines.zh: 我把喉咙鼓起来应它，两下跳拢。
lines.en: I puff my throat in answer. Two hops closer.
They will land in the water.
The water will look after them.
Then I return to my leaf.

lines.zh: 过后我又趴回浮叶，这边很静。
lines.en: Afterward I return to the pad. It's quiet.
Quiet enough. I wait for bugs.
The water's still warm. I'm in no hurry.
A bug. I snap my tongue out.
My tongue snaps out and sticks.
It sticks. I roll it back in.
Tongue back in. Far too small.
Too small. Not enough.
Not enough. I'll wait for another.

lines.zh: 我又等到一只，这只壳很硬。
lines.en: Another one comes. This shell is hard.
Too hard. I spit it out.

lines.zh: 吐出来之后，我抹了抹嘴。
lines.en: Spitting it out, I wipe my mouth.
I wipe my mouth and lie back down.
Something's moving at the surface.
Something stirs. I look up.
I look up. It's huge.

lines.zh: 那东西太大，我缩回水里。
lines.en: Too big. I shrink into the water.
I shrink into the water, eyes only.
I crouch low; it's still looking elsewhere.
I ease deeper.

lines.zh: 只留两眼在水面，它走远了。
lines.en: Only my eyes out, and it moves off.
It's gone. I surface.
I surface. All right.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底，它还在岸上。
lines.en: I keep to the bottom. It's still on the bank.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和淤泥一样，沉在底下。
lines.en: I match the silt and keep to the bottom.
The mud matches me.
On the bottom, I see it doesn't look down.
A bug lands in the water.

lines.zh: 有虫子掉进水里，我忍住没动。
lines.en: A bug drops in. I hold myself back.

lines.zh: 现在不是时候，它转身了。
lines.en: Not the time. It turns around.
It turns, and I rise slowly.
I lunge for the bug.

lines.zh: 我一下子扑过去，把它吞了。
lines.en: I lunge for the bug and swallow it.
I hop over and bump it.
Like a leaf falling on water.
After the bump, I push with my forelegs.

lines.zh: 两条前腿使劲推，它不动。
lines.en: I push with both forelegs. Nothing.
I'm far too weak.
It doesn't move. I hop away.
I splash it all over.
I hide under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我溅了它一身水，它仍站着。
lines.en: I splash it all over. It's still there.

lines.zh: 它还在那儿，我屏住呼吸。
lines.en: It's still there. I hold my breath.
Muddy water slides off my back.

lines.zh: 水面荡开一圈一圈的纹。
lines.en: Rings spread across the water.
I land in a patch of still water.
The water is shallow. The reeds are tall.
I hop onto a lily pad.
The pad rocks.

lines.zh: 浮叶打晃，我把身子压稳。
lines.en: The pad rocks. I steady myself.

lines.zh: 我稳住身体，岸边有影子。
lines.en: Steady at last, I see a shadow on the bank.

lines.zh: 岸上出现影子，我伏得更低。
lines.en: A shadow on the bank. I flatten lower.

lines.zh: 我一点点压低身子候着。
lines.en: I flatten down and wait.

lines.zh: 水热起来，我拼命往深处钻。
lines.en: The water heats and I dive deep.
I hit the surface and spread out.

lines.zh: 泡在水里，我偏偏透不过气。
lines.en: In the water, and I can’t get air.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从水里掀出来。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the water.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进水里，擦过我。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and grazes me.

lines.zh: 一道光下来，水面凝住了。
lines.en: A beam falls and the water sets.
Too hungry to hop.

lines.zh: 电沿水面追来，我僵在水里。
lines.en: Current skims the water and I freeze.
The water is gone and I fall.
